watched #Kantara : Just Vaaaaavvvvv!!!!!! Simple age old story of Landlord vs Tribals….but the approach of involving folk-fare, the terrific Visuals, terrific BGM, terrific Performances, terrific Action sequences are what which make this movie a MASTER PIECE!!!!! your eyes and ears cannot distract from what is being served on the Big Screen…..If there is any movie in the recent past which cannot be missed on Big Screen, then this is THE ONE

Rishab Shetty take a bow man!!!! before going to the movie I have obviously gone through all the reviews going gaga on how he is the Writer Director and Main Lead of the movie….but after watching the movie personally I felt he had no other option from donning the hat of all 3, as it would be impossible for any other person to understand and believe what he has on paper and how it would translate on to big screen 🙏 and what he has done in the last 20 mins on screen is simply he only can understand what he wants to do….TERRIFIC!!!

The way the movie was handled in complete Raw and Rustic way, the way each character arch has been addressed will simply blow your minds….

All said and done…this movie is not for normal cini goer or for those who seek entertainment and not even for those who has concern with the basic story telling approach of this movie!!!! But for those who seek a different Visual and Audio experience on Big Screen….you are in for a JAATHAAARAAA!!!!!

For years or probably decades Kanada Movie Industry was at rock bottom with even other language films out performing their movies in their own territory….Upendra was partially their saving grace and that too only for a limited audience!!! But in recent past and special mention to Hombale Films for bringing back the glory to Kanada film industry 🙏🙏🙏
